releaseNotes:
Fixes:
• Search Bar Cursor: Fixed cursor jumping to start after playing a search result; cursor now stays properly at the end (Shout-out to Vimal Updhyaya for reporting this!)
• App Update Dialog: Centered modal card design with full edge-to-edge support
• Media Player Art: Eliminated corner hairlines & polished Next Up queue

New Additions:
• Card Popup Modal Player: Smooth card expand and dismissal animations with background blur
• Seamless Song Playback: Tapping any song plays instantly in the background without forcing full-screen
• Home Category Filters: Category pills (Radio, Podcasts, Pop, Hip-Hop, Punjabi, Bollywood, Lo-Fi) directly under Home
• Trending Albums: Dedicated section tailored to your listening habits
• Onboarding Story: Interactive animated sticky note slides with wrap-up transitions
• Apple SF Pro Typography: System-wide typography refinements
